endorsements.name: Rajesh Singh
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-13382
endorsements.description: The Frontend File Manager Plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 23.4. This is due to the plugin not validating file ownership before processing file rename requests in the '/wpfm/v1/file-rename' REST API endpoint. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to rename files uploaded by other users via the 'fileid' parameter.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

endorsements.name: Rajesh Singh
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-6025
endorsements.description: The Order Tip for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Unauthenticated Improper Input Validation in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4. This is due to lack of server-side validation on the `data-tip` attribute, which makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to apply an excessive or even negative tip amount, resulting in unauthorized discount up to free orders depending on the value submitted.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
